english.title: Fail to furnish prescribed document of vehicle sale / disposal
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person by or through whom a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), had been sold or disposed of and who had failed to comply with regulation 12 or 12A of the Road Vehicle (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 1971 requiring you to furnish a prescribed document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), failed to comply with a notice served on you by the Secretary of State requiring you to give such information as was in your power to give

(A)_[as to the identity of]_
(B)_[which may have led to the identification of]_

a person

(C)_[who was keeping the vehicle, or who had kept it]_
(D)_[by, through or to whom the vehicle had been sold or disposed of]_

(E)_[at a specified time, namely **(..SPECIFY DATE AND TIME..)]_
(F)_[during a specified period, namely **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46A(3) and (4) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For the purposes of Section 46A of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994, "specified" means specified in a notice under subsection (2) of that section.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
